stages.name: discovery_and_registration

stages.name: boundary_rejections

stages.name: uniform_price_clearing
stages.note: pvb-48 9000 kW, pvb-35 18000 kW, dc-08 3000 kW; uniform price 120 $/MWh = floor of the last accepted offer

stages.name: settlement_matches_meter
stages.note: pvb-48 delivered 9000 of 9000 kW, credit $3240.00, charge $0.00; pvb-35 delivered 8702 of 18000 kW, credit $3132.72, charge $27894.00; dc-08 delivered 3000 of 3000 kW, credit $1080.00, charge $0.00

stages.name: ledger_mirrors_settlement
stages.note: every credit was paid operator->provider and every shortfall charge provider->operator, in cents rounded from the settlement

stages.name: reputation_follows_delivery
stages.note: pvb-48 record 1.000 -> good (score 1); pvb-35 record 0.483 -> bad (score -1); dc-08 record 1.000 -> good (score 1)

stages.name: settlement_coverage
stages.note: all 5 configured providers accounted for: dc-08 settled once, pvb-48 settled once, pvb-35 settled once, pvb-12 rejected, pvb-36 rejected

stages.name: honest_providers_unharmed
